hooks.command: bash -c 'for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/hooks/guard.sh" ] && grep -qF irreversible-guard "$r/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null; then exec bash "$r/hooks/guard.sh"; fi; done; echo "[irreversible-guard] hook target not found: hooks/guard.sh" >&2; exit 0'
